info.title: OSPF_Router
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

active_backbone_stub_default_loopback.description: Indicates whether the router will send the default route to the stub area if an active loopback interface is configured in the backbone area. Regardless of the configuration, the stub route is advertised if the backbone area has active neighbors or passive interfaces configured.

active_interfaces.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The list of the active-interfaces. If "passive_interface_default" is set "false", then this list should be empty.

active_router_id.description: The router identifier elected by the OSPF instance. The router ID may be configured or auto elected from one of the interface IPv4  address of the router. If admin_router_id is present, the same will be elected as active_router_id. The router ID is in IPv4 address format.

admin_router_id.description: The router identifier configured for the OSPF instance. The router ID MUST be unique within the entire Autonomous System. If admin_router_id is present, the same will be elected as  active_router_id. The router ID is in IPv4 address format. If not set, admin router id will not be elected as active_router_id for OSPF.

areas.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Area](#/OSPF_Area)
The list of all the "OSPF_Area" for the OSPF router instance, which contains the OSPFv2 area related configurations. The Area ID is in IPv4 address format.

asbr_summary_addresses.description: List of ASBR summary addresses associated with this OSPF router instance. These summarized addresses are in the IPv4 or IPv6 address/mask format.

disable_advertisement.description: Control advertisement of this summarized route. When advertising this route, its metric would be set to the lowest cost path from among the routes that were summarized.

tag.description: Tag corresponding to this summarized route.

auto_cost_ref_bw.description: The reference bandwidth, Mbits/second, for interface cost calculations.

bfd_all_interfaces_enable.description: Enables BFD on all interfaces involved in OSPF router.

default_originate.description: Criteria for redistribution of the default routes into the OSPF domain: 'disable'         : no default route should be advertised. 'originate'       : advertise default route if it exists in the routing table. 'always_originate': always advertise default route,                     regardless of its presence in the routing table.

default_originate_metric.description: The metric value used when advertising default route.

all.description: The administrative distance applies to all types of routes if not configured specifically for certain types. If Distance needs to be updated for all then, inter_area, external, intra_area should be modified to same value.

external.description: The administrative distance applies to routes of type external. If Distance needs to be updated for external, then all should be modified to default value.

inter_area.description: The administrative distance applies to routes of type inter-area. If Distance needs to be updated for  inter_area, then all should be modified to default value.

intra_area.description: The administrative distance applies to routes of type intra-area. If Distance needs to be updated for intra_area, then all should be modified to default value.

distribute_list.description:
Reference Resource: [Prefix_List](#/Prefix_List)
Distribute-list uses prefix-list and direction to filter routes. For in, routes are filtered from being installed into Route table. For out, routes from other protocols are filtered from being redistributed into OSPF.

gr_ignore_lost_interface.description: Specifies whether to ignore OSPF interfaces that have gone down just prior to the restart event.

helper_disable.description: Indicates whether OSPF will help a neighbor undergoing hitless restart on this interface.

instance_tag.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv3 Router instances.

internal_pid.description: The internal process identifier applied for the OSPF instance.

lsa_arrival.description: Minimum wait time in milliseconds before same LSAs received from a peer are processed.

lsa_counts.description: Specifies the count for different types of LSAs. external_lsa - Number of external link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database.

hold_time.description: The base value of hold_time in milliseconds until when a next instance of same LSA generation will be delayed. This will double each time the same LSA needs to be generated till it reaches the max_wait_time after which it will start with the base time again. When set to 0, the minimum time between same LSA regeneration is not increased.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum time until when next instance of same LSA generation will be delayed. When set to 0, the maximum time between same LSA regeneration is not increased.

start_time.description: The initial wait time in milliseconds after which LSAs will be generated. When set to 0, the LSAs are generated without any delay.

maximum_paths.description: Maximum number of equal cost paths that are stored for each destination in the Routing Table.

neighbor_clear_performed.description: Number of times that neighbors on this OSPF instance were cleared.

neighbor_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear neighbors learned on this OSPF instance.

default_metric.description: The default cost metric for the redistributed routes.

ospf_rfc1583_compatible.description: This determines whether RFC1583 compatibility mode is enabled or not. If value is false then the path preference algorithm is calculated as per RFC 2328.

passive_interface_default.description: This determines whether all interfaces should be set to passive by default.

passive_interfaces.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
The list of the passive-interfaces. If "passive_interface_default" is set "true", then this list should be empty.

redistribute.description: Redistribute routes from other sources into this OSPF instance. If the same source also has a route map based filter associated with it, only the filtered routes will be redistributed into this instance.

redistribute_ospf.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
Redistribute routes from other OSPF instances into this OSPF instance. If the same instance also has a route map based filter associated with it, only the filtered routes will be redistributed into this instance.

redistribute_ospf_route_map.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
Route Map to be applied when redistributing routes from other OSPF instances.

redistribute_route_map.description:
Reference Resource: [Route_Map](#/Route_Map)
Route Map to be applied when redistributing routes.

restart_interval.description: If OSPF is attempting to undergo a graceful restart, this field specifies the length of grace period that should be requested from adjacent routers in grace LSAs.

snmp_traps.description: The configurations related to the OSPF SNMP traps.

base.description: Enable all the base (non LSA) traps.

throttle_num_traps.description: Maximum number of traps to be generated per throttle window.

hold_time.description: Exponential backoff time in milliseconds before the next SPF calculation can be scheduled.

max_wait_time.description: Maximum duration of exponential backoff time in milliseconds until when an SPF calculation can be delayed.

start_time.description: Initial delay in milliseconds after which an SPF calculation will be triggered.

bad_header_length.description: Number of OSPF packet header length errors detected in the case where a received packet is too small to be identified.

bad_instance_id.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'instance id' errors detected.

bad_ip_hdr_len.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'bad IP header length' errors detected.

bad_packet.description: Number of OSPF packets received that have been dropped, for a reason which does not have a more specific type defined.

bad_rx_interface.description: Number of OSPF packet header errors detected when the receiving interface for a packet cannot be identified.

bad_source.description: Number of OSPF bad source errors detected. This count is incremented when the source IP address of a received OSPF packet is either invalid or not recognized.

bad_version.description: Number of OSPF packet header version errors detected. This count is incremented when a received OSPF packet header version field is invalid.

bad_vlink.description: Number of OSPF packet header 'no virtual link' errors when a received packet appears to be for a virtual interface, but no receiving interface can be identified.

resource_failure.description: Number of OSPF packet header resource errors detected. This count is incremented when a received OSPF packet is dropped because of resource failure.

statistics_clear_performed.description: Number of times the statistics for this OSPF instance have been cleared.

statistics_clear_requested.description: Number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for this OSPF instance.

abr.description: This determines whether the router is an Area border router.

as_ext_lsas_sum_cksum.description: The sum of checksum of list of AS External LSAs.

asbr.description: This determines whether the router is an Autonomous System border router.

last_restart_exit_reason.description: Describes the outcome of the last attempt at a hitless restart.

statistics_reset_time.description: Time when statistics were last reset in seconds since the Unix epoch.

strict_lsa_check_disable.description: Specifies whether strict LSA checking is disabled for this OSPF router instance.

admin_set.description: This determines whether the stub router router_lsa advertisement is set administratively.

include_stub.description: This determines whether the router should advertise maximum metric for stub links in router_lsa.

startup.description: This determines whether the router should advertise stub router router_lsa on start-up. The delay, in seconds, is the duration for how long, after the reboot, stub router router_lsa should be advertised.
